audit.why: 50.11% over 455 games supports EVEN at 5.5/10; the mirror did not move difficulty.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with the packet chart: Level 2 read K'Sante, Levels 4-5 read Skill, First item read K'Sante, 2+ items read K'Sante. The 4-5 row in particular contradicted its own why, which says 'stay back and Q-farm until level 6'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill/Skill/K'Sante/K'Sante/Skill/Skill/Sylas and the mirror flipped exactly these four.
audit.corrected: Level 2 to Skill, Levels 4-5 to K'Sante (6/10), First item to Skill, 2+ items to Sylas (4/10) — matched full/content pairs, with the four full-layer whys and content whys[6] rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's defect line is right that no K'Sante ability was named in the full layer — All Out was the only name, and only as a label. No cooldowns anywhere, and Path Maker's true damage was never stated.
audit.why: Kit: Ntofo Strikes is a 3.5s Q whose second stack fires a pull; Path Maker is 14/13/12/11/10s, takes reduced damage during the charge, and deals TRUE damage — stacking MR does not answer it; All Out is 120/100/80s and grants healing.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now names Path Maker and its true damage with the R's 120/100/80; phases[3].why names Ntofo Strikes and the 3.5s cadence.

audit.whatIsWrong: Generic itemization with no Grievous Wounds despite All Out granting healing, and 'Mercs or Steelcaps' offered as a coin flip against a kit whose signature damage is true.
audit.corrected: Itemization now buys Oblivion Orb ahead of his level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that Dauntless Instinct turns his next auto into the damage spike.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule autoreset-burst-tell: his abilities mark the target, and the marked basic attack is the payload.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d now names the mark and the follow-up auto.

edits.before: W online — the burst-heal turns even trades into wins. Take the extended trade only when his answer is down.
edits.after: E online, but Path Maker's charge-up eats your burst — take short trades only once you see his W spent.

edits.before: Weave passive autos between every spell. Trade around All Out and bank small HP leads — they compound at 6.
edits.after: He stacks Ntofo Strikes at range on a 3.5s Q and the two-stack pull locks you — farm back and wait for 6.

edits.before: Riftmaker spike — your full chain with the W heal wins almost any extended 1v1 that starts even.
edits.after: Riftmaker feeds your W heal, but his first defensive item absorbs it — trade only on his W cooldown.

edits.before: Two items plus a stolen ult makes you a teamfight flex — flank, burst the carry, and steal the scariest R on cooldown.
edits.after: The 1v1 stays his, but two items and a stolen All Out make you the better teamfighter — flank and isolate his carry.

edits.before: K'Sante's percent-HP passive and fighter-mode stats at 2+ items outpace your W sustain — Sylas wins only if his level-6 lead was converted into a durable advantage.
edits.after: The side-lane duel stays his, but two items plus a stolen All Out makes you the better teamfighter — flank, isolate his carry, and never trade him 1v1.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode — fight the tank, never the duelist. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E1 shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — 120/100/80s, and it heals him; Path Maker deals true damage, so MR will not save the trade. - Guard your E1 shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: That is K'Sante’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: His abilities mark you — the next auto is the real hit.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Riftmaker into Mercs or Steelcaps; then Zhonya's and Cosmic Drive. Abyssal Mask vs AP.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Riftmaker into Mercs; Oblivion Orb before he hits All Out — the R heals him. Then Zhonya's.

notes: 'K'Sante's percent-HP passive' appears in content spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late and wants.foe[2]. Riot's passive text says only that his abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next attack — there is no percent-health component in the kit file and no percentHealth flag. I corrected it in whys[6] (which I was editing anyway) and left the other five, since each needs its own band-fitting rewrite; they should all be revised. Also, wants.you[0] says his knockup leaves a 'stunned window' you land W into — Path Maker's stun is his, applied to you, not the reverse.
